prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Columbus Ohio for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist in Columbus—fit depends on your case, location, budget, and whether you prefer braces or Invisalign. For most people, the best choice is an **AAO-member, board-certified orthodontist** who personally evaluates you and offers both braces and clear aligners rather than steering every case into one option.

In Columbus, a practical way to find the right one is to book 2–3 free consultations with established orthodontic-only practices in the area. Ask each office:

- Is the doctor a **specialist in orthodontics** (not only a general dentist offering Invisalign)?
- Will the orthodontist—not just staff—plan and monitor my treatment?
- For my bite/crowding, do you recommend braces, Invisalign, or either—and why?
- What is the **all-in cost**, including retainers, X-rays/scans, attachments, refinements, broken brackets, and missed-appointment fees?
- How often will I see the orthodontist?
- How many similar adult/teen Invisalign or complex-braces cases do they treat?

A few selection tips:

- **For complicated bites, impacted teeth, major jaw discrepancies, or significant rotations**, braces may be more predictable than Invisalign; get at least two opinions.
- **For mild-to-moderate spacing/crowding**, Invisalign can work very well if you will wear trays about 20–22 hours/day.
- Don’t choose solely by an “Invisalign Diamond/Platinum” label. It indicates volume, not necessarily outcomes or attention from the orthodontist.
- Check the orthodontist’s credentials through the **American Association of Orthodontists (AAO) “Find an Orthodontist”** directory and confirm their license/disciplinary history with the **Ohio State Dental Board**.
- Look for review patterns—communication, billing transparency, wait times, treatment results—not just a high star rating.

If you share your Columbus neighborhood/suburb (e.g., Dublin, Hilliard, Westerville, New Albany, Grove City, Pickerington), whether the patient is an adult or child, and whether you prefer braces or Invisalign, I can help you build a focused shortlist and compare consultation quotes.
